guardrails-poc.purpose: Check that AI safety guardrails really stop attacks aimed at our bank
guardrails-poc.who: Bank AI team and security reviewers
guardrails-poc.asis_user: Vendor reports looked good, but none tested our own bank business
guardrails-poc.tobe_user: A 3,600-question test shows which rule stopped which kind of attack
guardrails-poc.asis_biz: Papers only proved the process was followed, not that AI answers were safe
guardrails-poc.tobe_biz: Advice: skip the add-on guardrail; the question set can check every AI assistant

agentic-platform-eval.purpose: Pick an AI agent platform that will not fail us, before we buy it
agentic-platform-eval.asis_user: Teams often found missing key features only halfway through
agentic-platform-eval.tobe_user: 26 hands-on tests found 4 problems that would block launch
agentic-platform-eval.asis_biz: A wrong pick was costly, and security holes could surface after launch
agentic-platform-eval.tobe_biz: Both platforms scored side by side on one sheet, the basis for the final pick

agent-cost-roi.purpose: Decide which of four AI assistants should get resources first
agent-cost-roi.asis_user: Before spending, business units could not see how an assistant would work
agent-cost-roi.tobe_user: Four working prototypes, one per stage from winning customers to wealth care
agent-cost-roi.asis_biz: The four served different people at different costs, so none could be compared
agent-cost-roi.tobe_biz: One cost-benefit table compares them, and estimates can be tracked after launch

agent-loan-assistant.purpose: Make sure loan applicants always get their questions answered
agent-loan-assistant.who: Loan applicants and the business unit
agent-loan-assistant.asis_user: Customers with questions often left when no one replied in time
agent-loan-assistant.tobe_user: Prototype built; once live, AI answers at once and guides the application
agent-loan-assistant.asis_biz: There was no way to measure how many extra applications AI could win
agent-loan-assistant.tobe_biz: Value measured by conversion rate; the baseline awaits business volume data

agent-credit-review.purpose: Help underwriters spend less time checking documents, so loans are approved faster
agent-credit-review.asis_user: Underwriters checked income papers one by one, slowly and unevenly
agent-credit-review.tobe_user: Prototype built; AI reads papers, checks them and works out income, with reasons
agent-credit-review.asis_biz: Case volume grew every year, yet no one knew the cost of each case
agent-credit-review.tobe_biz: Cost per case and a three-year cost baseline are set, with work run off-peak

agent-customer-service.purpose: Let call agents focus on customers while an AI sidekick handles the busywork
agent-customer-service.who: Call agents and call center managers
agent-customer-service.asis_user: Agents looked things up while listening, then wrote notes after every call
agent-customer-service.tobe_user: Prototype built; an AI sidekick finds facts, drafts replies and sums up calls
agent-customer-service.asis_biz: Calls bunch at peak hours: too few resources jam, too many waste money
agent-customer-service.tobe_biz: A call volume baseline and cost per call are set; resources await the vendor

agent-wealth-assistant.purpose: Customers learn where their assets stand by asking one question
agent-wealth-assistant.asis_user: Customers dug through many accounts to piece together what they own
agent-wealth-assistant.tobe_user: Prototype built: ask once in the app to check accounts or money questions
agent-wealth-assistant.asis_biz: No one knew if the Q&A worked or if resources would hold as use grew
agent-wealth-assistant.tobe_biz: Q&A proven to work; launch resources and three-year usage are estimated

agent-governance.purpose: Give every AI a clear compliance check before it goes live
agent-governance.who: AI project teams and compliance leaders
agent-governance.asis_user: Project teams did not know what to check before an AI went live
agent-governance.tobe_user: Framework designed: fill all nine boxes with proof and the AI passes
agent-governance.asis_biz: Existing rules covered paperwork only; no one checked AI answers or actions
agent-governance.tobe_biz: Planned for the bank rulebook: no check report, no launch

finllm.purpose: Make sure a finance-only AI model learns from correct data
finllm.who: The finance industry and FinLLM program
finllm.asis_user: Raw data had to be checked and fixed item by item, with no shortcut
finllm.tobe_user: A fixed-step cleaning process now applies to more items
finllm.asis_biz: Flawed data could teach the model errors, even answers that break rules
finllm.tobe_biz: Batch 2-1 cleaning and batch 4 regulation scoring are done

gemini-training.purpose: Help staff see how AI fits their own work, and use it safely
gemini-training.asis_user: Staff got the tool but did not know which tasks suit AI
gemini-training.tobe_user: Outline set; classes will practise on each unit's own work
gemini-training.asis_biz: The bank pushed AI use without knowing if staff used it safely
gemini-training.tobe_biz: Attendance and the AI use ideas learners bring back will be tracked

ai-ops-dashboard.purpose: Answer leaders' top question: are our AI investments worth it?
ai-ops-dashboard.asis_user: Each AI effort kept its own numbers, and one had no dashboard at all
ai-ops-dashboard.tobe_user: In planning: one five-part metric set for internal tools and customer AI
ai-ops-dashboard.asis_biz: No single view showed whether AI spending was worth it
ai-ops-dashboard.tobe_biz: Once built, leaders can compare results and costs side by side

a2ui-research.purpose: Let AI reply with bank-approved charts and forms instead of long text
a2ui-research.who: Wealth app customers and the bank
a2ui-research.asis_user: Money answers in long text were hard for customers to read
a2ui-research.tobe_user: In research: asset overview, product comparison and form filling picked
a2ui-research.asis_biz: Letting AI write web page code would never pass security review
a2ui-research.tobe_biz: By design, AI lays out the screen while the bank approves the parts

webai-finance.purpose: Let researchers spend time on research, not on gathering data
webai-finance.who: Group researchers and all group staff
webai-finance.asis_user: Researchers first had to gather reports, economic data and news daily
webai-finance.tobe_user: Live: pick a market or stock, ask AI, then ask follow-ups
webai-finance.asis_biz: The tool had to open to the whole group while keeping fund data apart
webai-finance.tobe_biz: One permission design keeps it open yet separated, inside the usual screen

ai-governance-review.purpose: Make reviews of the group's AI usage reports faster and consistent
ai-governance-review.asis_user: Reviewers read each report, redid risk levels and matched asset lists by hand
ai-governance-review.tobe_user: Live: the system judges, recalculates and cross-checks before reviewers look
ai-governance-review.asis_biz: Each reviewer judged differently, so subsidiary reports were held unevenly
ai-governance-review.tobe_biz: Every subsidiary is reviewed to one standard, with suggested fixes

rag-support-bot.purpose: Let members find answers in the technical manuals with one question
rag-support-bot.asis_user: Answers were scattered across manuals, so members waited for support
rag-support-bot.tobe_user: Live: ask in everyday words and get an answer in about 2 to 3 seconds
rag-support-bot.asis_biz: Manuals changed often, and retraining an AI model each time cost too much
rag-support-bot.tobe_biz: Accuracy rose from 60% to 85%, and admins update the knowledge base themselves

multi-agent-advisory.purpose: Have AI split work like a fund team to make investment calls that can be checked
multi-agent-advisory.asis_user: One AI struggled to cover charts, news mood and company basics at once
multi-agent-advisory.tobe_user: Five AI roles split the work and debate, then give a buy or sell signal
multi-agent-advisory.asis_biz: Advice came with no visible reasoning, so decisions could not be checked
multi-agent-advisory.tobe_biz: Tested on three years of Taiwan stock history, giving the team confidence

asr-transcription.purpose: Cut the time the research team spends writing up earnings calls
asr-transcription.asis_user: Someone typed up each call by ear, then pulled out the key points
asr-transcription.tobe_user: Live: recordings turn into transcripts and a key-point table automatically
asr-transcription.asis_biz: Transcripts alone were not enough; key points were hard to compare or quote
asr-transcription.tobe_biz: Write-ups take less time, and key points compare across firms and quarters

financial-statement-vlm.purpose: Read every figure accurately, even from scanned financial statements
financial-statement-vlm.asis_user: Scanned statements were images, and old text recognition missed the tables
financial-statement-vlm.tobe_user: Live: AI reads layout, tables and words together
financial-statement-vlm.asis_biz: Figures were hard to match to the right line item and period
financial-statement-vlm.tobe_biz: Now part of the statement data flow, matching figures to items and periods

moda-t-ambassador.purpose: Help rural groups and small firms use generative AI too
moda-t-ambassador.asis_user: Without AI talent, they struggled to adopt new tools alone
moda-t-ambassador.tobe_user: Ambassadors work with firms to turn real problems into digital solutions
moda-t-ambassador.asis_biz: A digital gap and an industry talent shortage needed closing
moda-t-ambassador.tobe_biz: Helped bring in generative AI and smart devices, and promoted the policy

tmba-cta-taiex.purpose: Build a futures trading strategy that can be reproduced, measured and tested
tmba-cta-taiex.asis_user: A strategy that cannot be rerun may give different results on the same data
tmba-cta-taiex.tobe_user: A test setup now gives the same result every run
tmba-cta-taiex.asis_biz: Looking at returns alone hid how much risk was taken
tmba-cta-taiex.tobe_biz: Returns and risk are judged together, and it won 3rd at the showcase

tmba-event-earnings-call.purpose: Test whether earnings calls can become trading opportunities
tmba-event-earnings-call.asis_user: Whether earnings calls offer trades was only a hunch
tmba-event-earnings-call.tobe_user: A Taiwan stock strategy built around earnings calls and tested on history
tmba-event-earnings-call.asis_biz: No data showed the return or risk of such trades
tmba-event-earnings-call.tobe_biz: Return and risk were measured on history, and the research carried on

thesis-rag-panel.purpose: Let AI read financial reports to find signals that classic ratios miss
thesis-rag-panel.asis_user: Reports hold lots of text that common methods left unused
thesis-rag-panel.tobe_user: AI reads reports of 592 companies and gives six scores
thesis-rag-panel.asis_biz: Common ratios explained only a small part of stock price moves
thesis-rag-panel.tobe_biz: The share of returns explained rose from 5.14% to 63.73%

fubon-esg-portfolio.purpose: Answer whether ESG really pays off in stock investing
fubon-esg-portfolio.asis_user: Trainees needed hands-on experience of researcher and fund manager work
fubon-esg-portfolio.tobe_user: A three-month course with assignments and group talks every class
fubon-esg-portfolio.asis_biz: Whether ESG truly helps stock picking still needed testing
fubon-esg-portfolio.tobe_biz: ESG factors went into a Taiwan stock portfolio, reviewed by fund managers

thesis-esg-capital-structure.purpose: Find out whether ESG risk scores affect how Taiwanese companies are financed
thesis-esg-capital-structure.asis_user: Investors often use ESG risk scores to judge a company
thesis-esg-capital-structure.tobe_user: The thesis links ESG scores to how much companies fund by debt or equity
thesis-esg-capital-structure.asis_biz: Few people linked ESG scores to how companies raise money
thesis-esg-capital-structure.tobe_biz: Thesis completed and degree earned; findings still to be added

tunghai-english-ta.purpose: Help students learn core business courses well in English
tunghai-english-ta.asis_user: Students learning statistics, economics and finance in English needed help
tunghai-english-ta.tobe_user: In three English-taught courses, a teaching assistant helps students keep up
tunghai-english-ta.asis_biz: The school ran core business courses in English and needed TA support
tunghai-english-ta.tobe_biz: English-taught statistics, economics and finance courses run smoothly

finjourney.purpose: Let anyone see their whole financial picture and where the problems are
finjourney.asis_user: Spending, investments and insurance sat in separate sheets and apps
finjourney.tobe_user: Live: one map shows it all, and an AI adviser flags problems and fixes
finjourney.asis_biz: AI gets numbers wrong most easily, making money advice hard to trust
finjourney.tobe_biz: The system does all the math, AI only suggests plans, and 656 tests guard it

vibe-edge.purpose: Let one person do institution-grade quant research with results you can trust
vibe-edge.asis_user: AI makes strategy versions far faster than a person can check them
vibe-edge.tobe_user: AI writes research steps, and five layers run through to a paper trade list
vibe-edge.asis_biz: If AI could edit the tests or skip counting tries, results could not be trusted
vibe-edge.tobe_biz: Fixed tests AI cannot touch, with every try and every AI cost logged

fincli.purpose: Give quant research raw, traceable Taiwan stock data to work with
fincli.asis_user: Much Taiwan market data had no ready tool, so each site was wired by hand
fincli.tobe_user: After each close, 23 sources are fetched automatically, no manual work
fincli.asis_biz: Changing data while fetching would lose the original numbers for good
fincli.tobe_biz: Raw data is stored as is and traceable, with a health check every night

openstrategy.purpose: Find unusual stock moves around earnings calls and turn them into stock picks
openstrategy.asis_user: Each variable fetched its own data, and the research code was scattered
openstrategy.tobe_user: Organised into ten steps that fetch data once and share it
openstrategy.asis_biz: Whether prices moved unusually around earnings calls had no statistical basis
openstrategy.tobe_biz: Four significant factors form the picks; 2025 slightly trailed the market
